title: Sell My House Before Foreclosure in Virginia Beach, VA
description: Behind on your mortgage in Virginia Beach? How Virginia foreclosure works, how long you may have, and how selling before the sale can help.
h1: Sell My House Before Foreclosure in Virginia Beach, VA
lede: If you are behind on your mortgage, time matters. Here is how Virginia foreclosure works and what selling first can look like.
tldr: Virginia foreclosures are generally non-judicial and can move quickly, and a sale may be possible until the foreclosure sale takes place. This is general information, not legal advice. Talk to a Virginia attorney or HUD-approved housing counselor right away.

sections.html: Virginia foreclosures are typically non-judicial, handled through a deed of trust rather than a court case. Notice rules appear in Va. Code § 55.1-321. Because no court case is required, timelines can be short.

• Ask your lender about repayment plans, modification or forbearance.
  • Sell the house and pay off the loan from proceeds.
  • Consider a deed in lieu, covered in this overview from the National Law Review.

See this HomeLight overview of selling before foreclosure.

sections.h2: If You Owe More Than the House Is Worth
sections.html: A sale that does not cover the loan needs lender approval, sometimes called a short sale. That takes longer, so start early and get legal advice.

faqs: Can I sell my house while in foreclosure?
In most cases yes, until the foreclosure sale takes place. Move quickly and confirm with an attorney.
Will a sale hurt my credit?
Paying the loan in full through a sale is generally better than a completed foreclosure, but ask a housing counselor about your situation.
On a direct purchase there is no listing commission. Closing costs apply and I will itemize them before you decide.
No. Talk with a Virginia attorney or HUD-approved counselor.
